invariant: ClusterDecoration translates the complete USymbolRectangle.asBig block to RectangleArea.getPosition(). The rectangle border is drawn at local (0,0), and the title is drawn from that same local origin at y = 2 + stereotype height. For a title without a stereotype, the SVG text baseline is therefore the normalized cluster origin plus the shared package title baseline; there is no additional border-inset translation.
causal_divergence: The painted-frontier fix moved the Rust rectangle border from cluster.y + 1 to the normalized cluster origin, matching Java's RectangleArea. The title expression retained its old trailing +1 compensation, however, so the border is exact while every rectangle title remains one pixel too low. An independent checker rejected the change on top-to-bottom, left-to-right, and competing-envelope-owner inputs, all with the same primitive-local error.
planned_change: Anchor the rectangle title baseline directly to the same normalized y origin used by its border by deleting the obsolete one-pixel addition. Preserve the existing centered x calculation and shared text metrics. Re-run all preserved rejected rectangle counterexamples plus fresh direction, stereotype, nesting, and competing-owner perturbations under an independent checker.
